'''Lemon Stone''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Lemon Stone per year on the [[Dwarf]]'s birthday, [[Summer|Summer 22]].

Lemon Stone is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Lemon Stone is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Lemon Stone is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Happy Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt190.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
